stage_upper_formula: scaled current serial CPU token work + original T4 total (original token stage bounds the unknown GPU prior, conservatively including its old CPU work)
stage_interval_formula: [scaled current serial CPU token work + original T4 non-token remainder, scaled current serial CPU token work + original T4 total]
assumptions: The two whole-process ratios are rounded/full-precision forms of one transfer assumption, not independent calibrations.
The selected 48-pair mean transfers to all 600 pairs; one observation per pair, no timing noise floor.
The whole-process host/T4 ratio is applied to all current serial CPU token work, including C; this is an assumption, not an independently measured CPU ratio.

The GPU prior on the rewritten receiver does not exceed the entire original T4 token stage. That stage also includes original CPU work, so this is a deliberately loose upper envelope, not an isolated GPU measurement.
The remaining original T4 work (renderer, setup, I/O and outer overhead) transfers unchanged; current receiver T4 overhead is unmeasured.
No claim that the conditional stage envelope bounds arbitrary hosts, contention, filesystem behavior or dependency versions.
